product_results.description: Hartz Nature’s Shield Flea & Tick Dog Shampoo contains plant extracts with proven safe and effective protection against fleas, flea eggs and ticks by contact, while repelling mosquitoes for up to 24 hours (when used as directed). This flea & tick shampoo combines a unique blend of natural essential oils, cinnamon, citronella and rosemary, into an effective formulation, creating a strong yet gentle defense for your dog year-round. Each 14oz bottle of naturally scented shampoo helps to nourish your dog’s skin and coat with Vitamin E and Glycerin, while providing maximized botanical protection against pests at the same time. This flea & tick shampoo with plant-based ingredients is free of parabens, dyes, and alcohols. When used as directed, Hartz Nature’s Shield Flea & Tick shampoo for dogs is safe to use around your children, your pets, and your home and is also safe to use for routine pet baths.

authors_reviews.title: Helps get rid of fleas naturally, makes fur shiny and soft
authors_reviews.text: Spring has sprung and so have the fleas. Every spring my dogs get bothered by fleas that are brought into our yard by stray cats in the neighborhood and I want a gentle solution to help relieve the itching and get rid of the fleas and eggs. This Hartz Nature’s Flea & Tick Dog Shampoo is made with the power of plants and herbals that fleas and ticks hate and naturally steer clear from. It lathers really nicely, making it easy to scrub all over my dogs fur and skin. The scent is very earthy, smells mostly like rosemary to me. I love how nourishing this shampoo is, my dogs’ coat is very soft and shiny after their bath. I have noticed that my dogs are scratching less already, I’m also treating their sleep area and our lawn separately so this entire process takes some time to eradicate the fleas and eggs from not only their fur and skin but also their living environment. Overall, this shampoo works well and I like that it is safe around my children and for my dogs. Would definitely recommend!
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

authors_reviews.title: Effective, but Could Smell Better
authors_reviews.text: This flea shampoo gets the job done! After just one use, it noticeably reduced the scratching and gave my dog some relief. It lathers nicely and rinses out easily, which is always a plus with a squirmy pet. My only wish is that it left a more pleasant scent behind—something fresh would be nice. Regardless, it works great, and I’d recommend it if you need something effective for flea control!
authors_reviews.author: ShopWithShanee

authors_reviews.title: Worked great to get rid of wet dog smell
authors_reviews.text: My older senior dog's hair tends to trap odors. Most shampoo 'scents' only last about a day and then she goes back to smell like her old self. Not this one, I actually have her smelling 'nice' for several days. Then seh rolls around in the grass and we are back to dog smell. BUT no fault of the shampoo. Easy to lather and rinsed off just fine. Happy to have her extra protected against fleas and ticks besides just her taking her monthly pill for these pests.
authors_reviews.author: L.A.T
